steps.label: Identify a, b, c and find √(a²+b²)
steps.margin_note: First mark. The coefficient of cos is NEGATIVE here — carry the minus, and note the square removes it anyway.
lines: Comparing with a sinx + b cosx + c:

recall.must_convey: That a = 3, b = −4, c = 0, and that squaring removes the minus so the root is still 5.
accept: a is three b is minus four and squaring removes the sign so the root is five
the cosine coefficient is negative but the square makes it positive
root of nine plus sixteen is five even with the minus
b minus four kani square cheste positive, root five
identify the coefficients including the minus

steps.why: Only the SIZE of the swing matters, not its direction — which is why a negative coefficient gives the same amplitude as a positive one.
common_mistakes: Writing b = 4 and losing track of the sign for no reason.
Getting √(9 − 16) and a negative under the root.

steps.label: Apply the max and min formulas
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Same as the twin — and the same answers, because the amplitude is the same.

recall.must_convey: That the maximum is 5 and the minimum is −5.
accept: maximum is five and minimum is minus five, same as the other question
the answers are five and negative five
both values come out the same as the twin

steps.why: This function is the previous one shifted sideways, not stretched — so it reaches exactly the same heights.
common_mistakes: Expecting a different answer because of the minus.
